$description: High Light Rituals (HLR) design tokens, Pack v0, lane B, 2026-10-18. DTCG format. Every $description opens with its provenance tag: [documented] the brand book (061022_HighLight_BrandBook_DS.pdf, cited by PDF page) or the client; [observed] live work (outputs/step-1-review/); [derived] our proposal, binding only once Eddie ratifies it (token-model.md’s ratification log records each ruling). Gate 1 picks C3, C4, C5, C6 and C8 go to HLR at Review 1. Font families name the real faces (C5); figma.yaml fonts.build_stand_ins names what the Figma build sets in their place (Gate 3 call 7, path 1). Gap register and the contrast law: token-model.md. Layout carries three canvas modes (web, social, email): one text style roster, sized by the frame's mode (Gate 2 question 1, Eddie, 2026-10-18).

com.hlr.status: ratified at Gate 2, 2026-10-22; alternate grounds named at Gate 4
com.hlr.mode_grammar: Semantic: $value is the light ground; each alternate ground (named at Gate 4) is stated on every semantic token as $extensions.com.hlr.modes.<mode>; the values in token-model.md section 2 (ratified at Gate 2, package call 2). Layout: canvas modes web (the default, $value), social (1080 canvases) and email (1200 masters), Gate 2 question 1 (Eddie, 2026-10-18). A Layout token whose value depends on the canvas states social and email under $extensions.com.hlr.modes, and every font.size and stroke token must; a Layout token without modes holds its $value on every canvas. A master sets its canvas mode; an element stays on Auto and takes the mode of the frame it sits in.

contrast-pairs.$description: [documented] The contrast law's certified pairs (floors: body 4.5, display 3.0, ui 3.0; WCAG 2). Light-mode semantic pairs, then the C4 alternate grounds as primitives (the warm, deep and night modes, named at Gate 4, for Eddie to confirm), then recorded entries with empty roles and a restriction: three failures, and copy over a placeholder image well, which is judged on the real image at review instead (Eddie, 2026-10-18). The law in prose: token-model.md. (ratified 2026-10-22 by Eddie, Gate 2 package call 2)
